cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

mechanism: A grants only literal picnic arrangements and taste discussion, controlling the agenda to prevent inquiry into the separation request.
confusable: D85 urgently repairs while hiding A role; D86 primarily keeps discussion away from why the relationship changed.
comparison: A literal space diversion at a picnic differs from controlling wedding-video sections to avoid separation talk.
seedUse: Use D86-a space ambiguity and B refusal to be moved; mustard remains the already established sandwich topic.
